commands.whisper_desc: Enables the /whisper+ command that does global whisper in a map room
commands.w_desc: Enables the /w+ command that does global whisper in a map room
commands.dropkeys_desc: Drops the specified keys: gold, silver, or bronze. You can also use all.
commands.crab_desc: Uh oh! Sin left a highly volatile debug command in! It's highly volatile, could do just about anything... even make noise!
commands.dropkeys_missing_arg: You must supply which key to drop, or 'all' to drop them all.
commands.dropkeys_not_map: Keys only work on a map...
commands.perf_mem_inspect: CRABS: Memory stats printed to the browser developer console (F12).
commands.perf_flushed: CRABS: Asset and drawing caches successfully purged.
